primer: TORPC tier-2. Numbers are ALREADY DECIMAL (NOT hex); events/functions are DECODED with named args (e.g. {event:"Transfer", args:{from,to,value}}); field names are compacted.

questions.prompt: How many log entries are in this result?
How many distinct contract addresses emitted these logs?
In the first ERC-20 Transfer log in this result, what is the recipient (to) address?
In the first ERC-20 Transfer log in this result, what is the transferred amount as a decimal integer?
